intro: Coating is quoted per part, not off a price list. What a job costs depends on the process, the substrate, the geometry, the volume, the surface prep required, and the finish spec you have to hit — and any shop that hands you a flat number before seeing the part is guessing. Send us a drawing, a sample, or a description of the part and the environment it lives in, and we will come back with a real quote and tell you which of our five processes fits it. Runs from a single piece to entire truckloads are all quoted the same way.
notes: There is no minimum order. Custom color matching is available across powder, batch and dip coating. Custom packaging to your specification and expedite service can both be quoted with the job.
